name: BRAND TEXT
description: LuxSauna was a reputable luxury infrared company that was based in Tampa, Florida. LuxSaunas opened in 1999 and led the way in infrared sauna technology for the home before closing in 2012. In its years of operation, LuxSauna sold approximately 20,000 infrared saunas to satisfied customers across the USA and beyond.  LuxSauna’s mission was to create a luxury and holistic infrared sauna experience in the home. They sought to inspire the nature of the human spirit by focusing on natural solutions for health complaints, encouraging people to move away from chemical laden remedies one infrared sauna session at a time. LuxSauna models and features embody the company’s passion for improving lives. LuxSauna’s insistence that environmental responsibility is a corporate responsibility led to its founders investing in our environmental future, fusing together the holistic elements of personal and environmental health.  The carbon boost technology used by LuxSaunas is environmentally friendly and at the time set a new standard in sauna heater technology. Studies have shown that carbon boost heaters designed by LuxSaunas can generate 339% more sweat than other infrared saunas. This healthy sweat removes toxins from the body and the dry heat generated by LuxSauna’s carbon boost heaters mimics the natural body for maximum deep heat penetration. LuxSaunas provide a soothing environment while ridding your body of toxins and impurities. After a single use of a LuxSauna customers report feeling healthier and more energetic. After regular use this feeling is compounded ensuring customers have a calmer approach to life, feel less stress and a greater sense of well being.  If you purchased your LuxSauna direct from the company or via a dealer, Infrared Sauna Parts can help with any mechanical problems you may start to have after prolonged use. We can help you with the LuxSauna branded carbon boost ceramic heater and control panels that you may think can no longer be replaced or repaired. Please contact us for further information.
